scope: Created-group settings, explicit leader and assignments, stable in-flight group context, existing Bot conversation entry, model setup and return to preserved team drafts
skipped: Existing Linux-only file-descriptor race and dedicated UID checks on macOS.

behaviorEvidence.groupSettings: Existing group rows are updated atomically with a configuration-only CAS hash. One-member groups remain groups; first member is the explicit leader; planned groups require complete exact-member assignments. No Bot definitions or primary Bot state are changed.
behaviorEvidence.activity: Read status and message activity do not invalidate the settings revision. GET and no-op saves do not write configuration. Invalid input, stale revisions and authorization failures leave the transaction unchanged.
behaviorEvidence.scope: Real platform HTTP checks members retain existing group-edit rights, while anonymous/foreign accounts and stale or missing expected-account headers are rejected. Source shared main DMs are protected and ordinary DMs are not group settings.
behaviorEvidence.legacy: Existing membership edits and Bot deletion reconcile stored lead/assignments rather than leaving contradictions; new members receive an explicit pending-assignment label.
behaviorEvidence.runtime: Actual Pi SDK against a synthetic endpoint verifies planned and manual group root/child snapshots, unchanged in-flight instructions, rejected new candidates in an old root, new-root leader/configuration, and current-member checks for later delegation.
behaviorEvidence.runtimeBoundary: Removing a member blocks subsequent delegation; it does not automatically cancel already started root/child tasks. Previously queued messages keep their selected delivery agent.
behaviorEvidence.conversationEntry: Actual React and App handlers open only an existing matching one-Bot conversation, preserve dirty-setting confirmation, and do not create conversations or restore hidden roster entries. Team-visible and personal-private labels remain distinct.
behaviorEvidence.modelReturn: The original team subtree remains mounted while only the model settings dialog is active. Goal and edited plan survive return; generation still requires a separate click. Per-profile drafts and explicit activation behavior are preserved.
behaviorEvidence.modelIdentity: Model settings requests pin the opening workspace/account and ignore late results after unmount, identity or navigation changes. Actual HTTP validates supplied expected-account headers on listing/save/activation/deletion while retaining older headerless API compatibility.

testCorrections: The first new model-account fixture assumed a new workspace had no seeded messages. Its no-task assertion was corrected to compare the actual initial message baseline; authorization assertions were unchanged. Existing CreateDialog tests were updated to locate the Dialog under its new fragment wrapper without removing event assertions.

desktopPackage.note: Native client code is unchanged; the client loads the updated web UI from the separately running service. No repackaging or native GUI acceptance is claimed this stage.

limitations: Product browser control again reports Local browser use is disabled in Work settings; source-render/event/focus-listener tests are not visual, native or touch acceptance.
Existing group edits support 1–20 members and smart planning supports 1–5; official manual creation describes 2–6. This difference remains tracked, not declared 1:1.
Independent source-app/team-knowledge grants, avatar generation, full voice conversation and remaining multi-device product acceptance are still incomplete; the original goal remains active.
